tools.name: query_grades
tools.description: Purpose: search the carbon black grade benchmark library - ASTM D1765 native grades (N110-N990, SAF/ISAF/HAF/FEF/GPF/SRF/MT/FT), conductive specialty benchmarks (acetylene black, Super P, ENSACO 250G, Vulcan XC-72R, Ketjenblack EC-300J/EC-600JD) and rCB types - with 6 standard parameters each (iodine_absorption, dbp_absorption, bet_surface_area, ash_content, heating_loss, sieve_residue_325mesh). Guidelines: combine type='native'/'conductive'/'rcb', category (e.g. 'HAF','FEF'), keyword ('N550','N330','Super P'); use as the anchoring benchmark layer before any rCB vs native comparison; rCB records include vs-N550 gap analysis. Limits: 63 records (29 native + 6 conductive + 2 rCB types) - spec ranges, not lot CoA; ash gap (rCB 8-15% vs N550 <=0.5%) caps rCB at semi-reinforcing uses. Ex: 'N330 standard parameters', 'conductive carbon black for lithium battery', 'rCB vs N550'.

keyword.description: 牌号/名称关键词，如 'N550'、'N330'、'HAF'、'FEF'、'Super P'、'rCB-General'

type.description: 类型过滤：native=原生炭黑, rcb=再生炭黑, conductive=导电特种炭黑

category.description: 段位过滤，如 'SAF'（超耐磨）、'ISAF'（中超耐磨）、'HAF'（高耐磨）、'FEF'（快压出）、'GPF'（通用）、'SRF'（半补强）、'MT'（中粒子热裂）、'FT'（大粒子热裂）、'导电'（conductive 类）

tools.name: get_grade
tools.description: Purpose: fetch one carbon black grade in full - the six ASTM parameters as min/max ranges with their test-method standards, application list, process route, brand owner for conductive grades, and for rCB types a gap analysis against the virgin N550 anchor on iodine / DBP / BET / ash / heating loss / sieve residue. Guidelines: use the semantic id (rcb-grade-n550 / rcb-grade-xc72 / rcb-grade-rcb-general) or the grade name ('N550', 'Super P','rCB-General');  pair with query_grades to discover ids and get_grade_spec for specification detail. ⭐ Scope: this returns the FULL business record (application, process route, brand owner, rCB-vs-N550 gap analysis). For a bare ASTM parameter table only, use get_grade_spec instead. Limits: one grade per call; ranges are compiled from public specifications and are not a supplier's guaranteed certificate of analysis; the gap analysis is relative to N550 only, not to every virgin grade. Ex: get_grade(id='rcb-grade-n550'), get_grade(name='Super P'), get_grade(name='rCB-General', response_format='json').

id.description: 语义化实体 ID，如 rcb-grade-n550 / rcb-grade-xc72 / rcb-grade-rcb-general

name.description: 牌号名（与 id 二选一），如 'N550'、'N660'、'N330'、'Super P'、'rCB-General'

tools.name: calculate_saving
tools.description: Purpose: substitution economics compute for carbon black - given a native price (vcb_price_input), an rCB price (rcb_price_input) and replacement ratio, returns per-ton saving and optional annualized value. Guidelines: supply your own quotes, or fetch market anchors via get_rcb_index first. Limits: pure arithmetic - no market data access, not a price recommendation. Ex: 'N330 12000 RMB/t vs rCB 8000 RMB/t, ratio 0.3, annual 5000t'.

vcb_price_input.description: 原生炭黑价格（正数，调用方提供）

rcb_price_input.description: rCB 价格（正数，调用方提供）

annual_volume_t.description: 可选，年用量（吨），用于年化

tools.name: compare_rcb
tools.description: Purpose: quality benchmark - compare measured rCB sample parameters against a target native carbon black grade (e.g. N550) spec ranges; classify each parameter pass / light deviation / significant deviation. Guidelines: pass target_grade plus rcb_params using EXACT keys - iodine_absorption, dbp_absorption, bet_surface_area, ash_content, heating_loss, sieve_residue_325mesh, ph_value, pour_density (NOT OAN/BET/ash). ideal for grading incoming rCB lots against a native anchor before substitution decisions. Limits: needs measured values as input - no lab data on file; thresholds follow the site's anchored-benchmark methodology, not customer specs. Ex: 'compare rCB sample vs N550'.

tools.name: get_elt_price_index
tools.description: Purpose: rCB feedstock (end-of-life tyre) price index in GLOBAL caliber - Tier 1 global categories (scrap tyre collection price / tyre pyrolysis oil / crumb rubber / recovered steel wire / rCB) with region-by-region indices benchmarked to the global weighted average = 1000, plus Tier 2 region-specific categories (EU/US gate fee and TDF; CN rubber fuzz, rubber block, 900-mesh and 24-mesh powder). The first category is the scrap tyre collection price (G-ELT) - the single largest cost item for rCB producers. Guidelines: no arguments returns the global cross-section with region spreads; pass region (EU/US/CN/CA/IN) for that region's index across categories; pass category (G-TPO/G-CRB/G-WIRE/G-RCB) for one category's region comparison. Pair with get_feedstock_overview for arisings and processing paths, and get_rcb_index for layered rCB product prices. Also returns a PUBLIC-SOURCE INDEX SERIES (monthly, base month = 1000) covering the tyre value chain: scrap tyre, 24-mesh crumb rubber, pyrolysis oil, and virgin carbon black grades N220/N330/N550/N660, with category-to-anchor ratios - use it for trend direction and cross-category structure (the virgin carbon-black grades act as the rCB benchmark). This series is index-only and unit-less: it cannot be reverse-engineered into absolute prices. Limits: index values, region spreads and ratios only - absolute prices and source platforms are never disclosed because no official public statistics source exists for ELT feedstock prices worldwide; some regions are excluded from a category when the product caliber is not comparable (e.g. China's bead wire is a finished product vs the recovered mixed wire traded in the EU/US). Ex: 'global tyre pyrolysis oil price index vs China', 'crumb rubber price by region', 'which region has the highest TPO price'.

region.description: 可选：区域代码 EU / US / CN / CA / IN —— 返回该区域在各全球品类上的指数

category.description: 可选：全球品类代码 G-TPO(裂解油) / G-CRB(胶粉) / G-WIRE(钢丝) / G-RCB(再生炭黑)；或区域品类 R-GATEFEE 等

tier.description: 可选：1=全球通用品类，2=区域特定品类

tools.name: get_feedstock_overview
tools.description: Purpose: overview of the rCB feedstock module beyond prices - waste tyre arisings and recovery volumes by region (China, EU, US, global) with official sources, the processing-path value ladder (retreading > material recycling > energy recovery > civil engineering > landfill), and the categories covered by the module. Guidelines: pass region (CN/EU/US) to focus the arisings table; use this before quoting feedstock availability or recovery-rate figures, then get_elt_price_index for prices. Limits: arisings and recovery rates are drawn from official and industry-association sources with the statistical body labelled per record - figures from different bodies differ by scope and must not be merged; does not return prices. Ex: 'waste tyre recovery volume China 2025', 'how are end-of-life tyres processed', 'EU tyre recovery rate'.

region.description: 可选：区域代码 CN / EU / US / GLOBAL

tools.name: get_elt_recycling

Guidelines: call with no arguments for the full topic, or pass topic (policy/standard/network/ladder/market) to focus one section; pair with get_elt_price_index (category G-ELT) for collection prices and get_feedstock_overview for arisings. Limits: policy and standard records are sourced from official documents; market-size figures are public-information compilations and labelled as such; does not return prices. Ex: 'China end-of-life tyre recycling policy 2030 target', 'ELT collection network China', 'scrap tyre pyrolysis standards 2026'.

topic.description: 可选：policy(政策目标) / standard(标准体系) / network(回收网络) / ladder(价值阶梯) / market(市场数据)

tools.name: get_price_trend
tools.description: Purpose: native carbon black / rCB price trend direction with official anchors only (no raw quote tables). Guidelines: pass optional segment (domestic/export/import/feedstock/rCB) and period (e.g. 2026); use for directional questions like 'is rCB price rising'. Limits: trend direction and anchors only - no absolute quotes; pair with get_rcb_index for numbers. Ex: 'rCB price trend 2026 CN'.

segment.description: 可选：国内 / 出口 / 进口 / 原料 / rCB

tools.name: get_grade_spec
tools.description: Purpose: ASTM spec parameter ranges (min/max/unit/test method) for native carbon black grades N110-N990, conductive benchmarks and rCB grades - the standard-parameters reference for carbon black. Guidelines: pass grade (e.g. n330, n550) plus optional type (native/conductive/rcb); use to judge whether an rCB sample falls in spec (iodine_absorption, dbp_absorption, bet_surface_area, ash_content, ph_value). Limits: spec ranges only - not lot-specific CoA data.  Ex: 'N330 standard parameters', 'rCB N550 spec vs ASTM'. ⭐ Scope: SPEC-ONLY quick lookup (ASTM min/max/unit/test method). For application, process route, brand owner or rCB-vs-N550 gap analysis, use get_grade instead.

grade.description: 牌号或实体 ID，如 N550 / rcb-grade-n550

tools.name: get_substitution_boundary
tools.description: Purpose: four-dimension substitution boundary of rCB vs native carbon black - application limits, regulatory access, certification requirements, material spec constraints. Guidelines: pass dimension in {application, regulatory, certification, material_spec} or omit for all four; call before any substitution feasibility claim (e.g. 'can rCB replace N330 in tire?'). Limits: technical/regulatory possibility only, not commercial viability - pricing belongs to calculate_saving. Ex: 'rCB application limit in seals', 'rCB regulatory access EU'.

tools.name: get_announcements_timeline

Limits: announcement-derived items only - claims are not independently confirmed and full press-release text is not served; coverage depends on what companies have publicly announced, so absence is not evidence of inactivity. Ex: get_announcements_timeline(region='欧洲'), get_announcements_timeline(date_from='2026-01-01', limit=50).

tools.name: query_cards
tools.description: Purpose: search the public knowledge-card collection - atomic sourced facts compiled from statistics, standards, papers and official announcements. Guidelines: keyword matches title and fact fields; combine type and region to narrow; every card returns its fact summary together with the source it was compiled from. Limits: publicly releasable cards only - cards marked excluded (with an excluded reason) are filtered out at export and never returned; each card is a single fact rather than analysis, and carries no recommendation.  Ex: query_cards(keyword='ISCC'), query_cards(type='标准解读', region='欧盟'). ⭐ Scope: the LEGACY knowledge-card layer (rCB-centric, small curated set). For multi-domain facts (carbon markets / telecom / health / energy / compute) with confidence grades and as-of dates, prefer query_domain_benchmarks instead - it is the current, larger benchmark layer.

tools.name: get_rcb_index
tools.description: Purpose: rCB price index query - returns the index (ABP), absolute reference price (ARP, USD/ton FOB) and AF/VF attribution decomposition for a grade level, period and region; native-carbon-black-anchored (N550 anchor method). Guidelines: pass grade (P1 refined / P2 standard / P3 industrial, default P2), date (YYYY-MM, blank = latest) and region (CN/EU/NA/SEA, default CN); pair with get_rcb_vcb_spread for discount and get_grade_trend for history. Limits: reference range computed from the anchor method - not a transaction price; VF factor is forward-only (no backfill before 2026-Q3). Ex: 'rCB index P2 CN 2026-09', 'current rCB reference price EU'.

date.description: 期别 YYYY-MM；留空取最新可用期

tools.name: get_rcb_vcb_spread
tools.description: Purpose: anchored spread between rCB and native carbon black - anchoring ratio rho, discount rate and price gap per grade/region/period; the quantitative 'how much cheaper is rCB' indicator. Guidelines: pass date (YYYY-MM), region (CN/EU/NA/SEA), grade (P1/P2/P3); pair with get_grade_trend for direction and calculate_saving for custom quotes. Limits: N550-anchored reference range, not transaction price; single-period snapshot, no forecast. Ex: 'rCB vs N550 discount CN 2026-09'.

tools.name: get_grade_trend
tools.description: Purpose: return the historical series of the layered rCB index for one grade tier - period-by-period assessed benchmark price, period-on-period change, anchor, adjustment factor and verification factor. Guidelines: grade defaults to P2 in the CN region; set start_date and end_date as YYYY-MM to slice a window; pair with get_rcb_index for the current cross-section and get_price_trend for category-level trends. Limits: index points only - dimensionless, non-tradable, and never to be converted into an absolute price; early periods may carry an anchor carried forward from an earlier month, and the output flags when this happens. Ex: get_grade_trend(grade='P2'), get_grade_trend(grade='P1', start_date='2025-12', end_date='2026-09').

tools.name: query_trade_flows
tools.description: Purpose: query global carbon black (HS 280300) bilateral trade flows from UN Comtrade official customs statistics - 1751 records, 8 reporters (CHN/USA/DEU/JPN/KOR/IND/THA/TUR) plus World totals, 2024-2025. Guidelines: pass reporter (ISO3 alpha), partner (ISO3/numeric/name), period (YYYY), flow (X=export/M=import) and limit; unit_price_usd_t and share_pct are derived fields (share excludes World); use for capacity shift, trade-partner concentration and price-gap structure analysis. Limits: customs-reported data only - no commercial quote platforms; unit prices with qty missing are flagged 'missing_qty'; guardrail band 300-8000 USD/t. Ex: 'China carbon black exports 2025', 'top US import partners HS 280300'.

reporter.description: 报告国 ISO3 字母码，如 CHN/USA/DEU/JPN/KOR/IND/THA/TUR

partner.description: 伙伴国筛选：ISO3/数字代码/中文名（部分支持），如 THA/764/泰国

period.description: 期间 YYYY（如 2024），留空取全部

flow.description: 流向 X=出口 / M=进口

limit.description: 返回条数上限（默认 20,最大 200）

offset.description: 起始偏移，默认 0；返回体 has_more=true 时用 next_cursor 作为下一页 offset

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: get_trade_flow_summary
tools.description: Purpose: aggregate the UN Comtrade carbon black (HS 280300) records for a period - per reporter totals for quantity and value, the weighted unit price, and the top-10 partner countries by quantity. Guidelines: pass period (YYYY) or leave empty to aggregate all periods (2024-2025); weighted price equals total value divided by total quantity; pair with get_trade_partner_ranking to drill into a single reporter. Limits: customs-reported totals only - no commercial quote platform data; World aggregate rows are excluded from partner rankings; unit prices are not comparable across reporters where quantity reporting is incomplete. Ex: get_trade_flow_summary(period='2025'), get_trade_flow_summary(response_format='json').

period.description: 期间 YYYY，如 2024；留空则汇总全部期间

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: get_trade_partner_ranking
tools.description: Purpose: rank partner countries for one reporter, period and flow direction by quantity, returning rank, partner, quantity, value, unit price and share. Guidelines: reporter (ISO3 alpha), period (YYYY) and flow (X =export, M = import) are required; raise top_n above the default 10 (max 50) only when a longer tail is needed.Limits: one reporter-period-flow combination per call; World aggregate rows are excluded; shares are computed within the returned set, not against global trade. Ex: get_trade_partner_ranking(reporter='CHN', period='2025', flow='X'), get_trade_partner_ranking(reporter='USA', period='2024', flow='M', top_n=20).

top_n.description: Top N 伙伴国（默认 10,最大 50）

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: get_trade_dataset_overview
tools.description: Purpose: describe the trade flow dataset - source, caliber, unit conversion, derived-field declarations, field table and compliance boundaries - so an agent can cite and interpret it correctly. Guidelines: call this before running any trade query that will be quoted; it states explicitly which fields are customs-reported and which are our own derivations. Limits: UN Comtrade official statistics only - no commercial quote platform data enters this dataset; this tool documents the dataset and returns no trade records itself. Ex: get_trade_dataset_overview(), get_trade_dataset_overview(response_format='json').

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: query_domain_benchmarks
tools.description: Purpose: search the cross-domain benchmark layer - the same verifiable-anchor methodology we apply to rCB, extended to other domains (carbon footprint & markets / telecom & space / health & nutrition / new energy & batteries / compute & energy). Records are policy milestones, official limit values, standards status and dated price snapshots, each with an issuer, an as-of date, a confidence grade and a source_url. Guidelines: filter by domain (carbon / telecom / health / energy / compute), region, category or confidence; every record is meant to be citable - pair with get_domain_benchmark by ID for the full record including the source link. Limits: anchor facts only - no price forecasts (carbon prices are dated snapshots, not live quotes), no medical or dosing advice, no diagnosis; the domain taxonomy is ours, not the issuing body's. Ex: query_domain_benchmarks(domain='carbon'), query_domain_benchmarks(keyword='CBAM'), query_domain_benchmarks(domain='health', confidence='A', language='en'), query_domain_benchmarks(domain='compute').

keyword.description: 关键词模糊匹配，如 'CBAM'、'3GPP'、'游离糖'、'碳市场'

domain.description: 领域过滤：carbon=碳足迹·碳市场 / telecom=通信·空间 / health=健康·营养 / energy=新能源·电池 / compute=算力·能源（可留空取全部）

region.description: 地区/组织过滤，如 '国际'、'欧盟'、'中国'

confidence.description: 置信度：A=官方一手来源核实, B=权威二手来源, C=待核实

verified.description: true=只看 A 级已核实条目

tools.name: get_domain_benchmark

Guidelines: pass the ID returned by query_domain_benchmarks (e.g. 'tbm-021') or a distinctive keyword; use this whenever a cross-domain fact is going to be quoted, so the citation carries a verifiable source link. Limits: one record per call; anchor facts only - carbon prices are dated snapshots rather than live quotes, and the health domain provides no diagnosis, treatment or dosing guidance. Ex: get_domain_benchmark(id='tbm-021'), get_domain_benchmark(keyword='CBAM', language='en').

id.description: 记录 ID，如 'tbm-021'（与 keyword 二选一）

keyword.description: 名称/键名关键词（与 id 二选一），如 'CBAM'、'PAS 2050'

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: get_cbam_timeline
tools.description: Purpose: the CBAM timeline as a single ordered view - from the founding regulation through the transitional period to the definitive regime and the surrender phase. Guidelines: call this first whenever a question involves CBAM dates, obligations or scope ("when does CBAM start", "when must certificates be surrendered"). Grouped into transitional/legislative, definitive and surrender phases by the as-of date of each source document. Limits: timeline only - dates come from the cited official documents and are not forecasts; the phase grouping is ours, not the EU's official staging. Pair with get_domain_benchmark(id=...) for the source URL of any node. Ex: get_cbam_timeline(), get_cbam_timeline(language='en').

response_format.description: 输出格式：markdown=人类阅读, json=Agent 处理友好

tools.name: get_carbon_market_overview
tools.description: Purpose: one-call overview of the carbon market layer - dated carbon price snapshots (EU ETS auction/settlement, China national ETS), market size statistics and allowance allocation rules, each with its issuer and source. Guidelines: use for "what is the carbon price / how big is the market / how are allowances allocated" style questions; filter by market to narrow to the EU or China. Limits: prices are dated snapshots from the cited sources, NOT live quotes; currencies are not converted, so do not compare across currencies without an FX rate. Ex: get_carbon_market_overview(), get_carbon_market_overview(market='cn'), get_carbon_market_overview(market='eu', language='en'). ⭐ Scope: ONE market at a time - price + market size + allocation rules together. For a side-by-side comparison across markets (who is more expensive, what is the spread), use compare_carbon_prices instead.

market.description: 市场过滤：all=全部 / eu=欧盟（EU ETS 碳价）/ cn=中国（全国碳市场）

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: get_carbon_standards
tools.description: Purpose: the carbon accounting standards library - ISO 14064 series, ISO 14067, ISO 14068-1, GHG Protocol and withdrawn standards such as PAS 2050, each with status, as-of date, issuer and confidence grade. Guidelines: use when a question involves which standard governs an organisation-level inventory, a product carbon footprint, or a verification statement; filter status='withdrawn' to check whether a standard still applies. Limits: standards catalogue only - no interpretation of how a standard applies to a specific company. Ex: get_carbon_standards(), get_carbon_standards(status='withdrawn'), get_carbon_standards(keyword='14067').

status.description: 状态过滤：all=全部 / current=现行 / withdrawn=已撤回

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: compare_carbon_prices
tools.description: Purpose: put every carbon price snapshot side by side - market/basis, value, unit, price date and source - and compute the spread within each currency. Guidelines: use for "how do EU and China carbon prices compare" or "what is the spread between auction and secondary prices"; same-currency spreads are returned as computed values. Limits: currencies are NOT converted - the tool deliberately does not produce a cross-currency difference, because that requires an FX rate the dataset does not carry; prices are dated snapshots, not live quotes. Ex: compare_carbon_prices(), compare_carbon_prices(language='en'). ⭐ Scope: SIDE-BY-SIDE comparison only (market/basis/value/unit/date/spread, same currency). For a single-market overview that also covers market size and allowance-allocation rules, use get_carbon_market_overview instead.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: check_rcb_compliance
tools.description: Purpose: rCB export-compliance checklist - PAH limits, SVHC obligations, food-contact rules and certification requirements for a given market and application. Guidelines: use for "can this rCB be sold in the EU / what PAH limits apply / what certifications do I need" questions; always state the application because the PAH limit differs (tire vs toy vs food-contact). Limits: distinguishes the REACH Annex XVII Entry 50 eight-PAH LIMIT list from the ECHA SVHC candidate-list PAH entries (notification duty) - these are different substance sets and must not be mixed; the stored limit values carry a "to be verified against EUR-Lex" note; this tool is not legal advice. Ex: check_rcb_compliance(market='EU', application='tire'), check_rcb_compliance(market='EU', application='toy').

application.description: 应用场景；决定 PAH 限值档（轮胎 ≤1 / 玩具 ≤0.5 mg/kg 等）

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: estimate_rcb_price
tools.description: Purpose: estimate an rCB reference price by multiplying a dated export-price anchor by a grade-tier discount and a regional coefficient, and explicitly state whether the result may be quoted externally. Guidelines: use for "what should rCB cost / how much cheaper than virgin / what budget should I plan" questions; always report the tier, region and period. Limits: this is an INDEX-DERIVED value, NOT a transactable quote; the anchor is an all-grades export average skewed to mid/low quality; only the CN regional coefficient is calibrated - EU/NA/SEA coefficients are uncalibrated and marked non-releasable, so those results are order-of-magnitude only. Ex: estimate_rcb_price(tier='P2', region='CN'), estimate_rcb_price(tier='P1', quantity=100).

tier.description: 档位：P1 精制 ρ=0.90 / P2 标准 ρ=0.80 / P3 工业 ρ=0.60

region.description: 区域；仅 CN 系数已校准可对外，其余为量级参考

period.description: 期间 YYYY-MM；不填用最新（当前 2025-12）

quantity.description: 数量（吨，可选）；给了会算总金额

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: select_rcb_grade
tools.description: Purpose: rCB grade selector - take measured carbon-black parameters (iodine adsorption, DBP, BET, ash) or a target native grade, and return the closest grade, the rCB tier, the recommended substitution ratio for the application segment, and the MUST-TEST list. Guidelines: use for "can this rCB replace N550 / what grade is this / how much can I substitute" questions; supply ash whenever possible because ash is the single most discriminating parameter between rCB and virgin carbon black. Limits: parameters are RANGES not exact values, substitution ratios come from public sources and business judgment and are NOT guarantees, and the tool never returns formulations, process parameters or customer data. Ex: select_rcb_grade(iodine=40, dbp=118, ash=6), select_rcb_grade(target_grade='N550', application='foam').

bet.description: BET 比表面积（m²/g），ASTM D6556（可选）

ash.description: 灰分（%），ASTM D1506（强烈建议提供，用于判 rCB 档位）

application.description: 用途段；决定建议替代比例

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: query_carbon_metrology
tools.description: Purpose: the 2026 catalogue of carbon-emissions metrology capacity - inspection parameters, measurement methods and reference standard devices published by SAMR. Guidelines: use when a question is about HOW a carbon quantity is measured (which instrument, which verification regulation, which reference device) rather than about an emission factor value. Limits: capacity/instrument catalogue, NOT an emission-factor database; filter with kind=params|methods|standard_devices + keyword. Ex: query_carbon_metrology(kind='params', keyword='温度').

kind.description: 只看某一类；不填返回全部

limit.description: 返回条数上限，默认 40

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: calculate_cbam_cost
tools.description: Purpose: a transparent CBAM cost estimate - embedded emissions multiplied by a carbon price. Guidelines: supply emission_intensity (tCO2e per tonne of goods) and quantity (tonnes); optionally supply carbon_price, otherwise the latest EU ETS EUA spot snapshot in the dataset is used and cited in the output. Use for order-of-magnitude questions about CBAM exposure. Limits: this is ONLY the emissions-times-price multiplication - it excludes free-allocation deduction, third-country carbon-price deduction and default-value mark-ups, so the result is NOT a declarable amount and is not advice; the emission intensity is your input, not our data. Ex: calculate_cbam_cost(emission_intensity=1.8, quantity=5000), calculate_cbam_cost(emission_intensity=2.1, quantity=1200, carbon_price=85).

emission_intensity.description: 隐含排放强度（吨 CO2e / 吨商品），由调用方提供

carbon_price.description: 碳价（可选）；不填则取库内最新 EU ETS EUA 现货快照并在输出中标注来源

offset.description: 起始偏移，默认 0；返回体 has_more=true 时用 next_cursor 作为下一页 offset

tools.name: calculate_recycled_content_gap
tools.description: Purpose: compare a given recycled-content figure against the statutory minimum for one material, at both stages. Guidelines: supply material (cobalt / lead / lithium / nickel) and current_pct; thresholds are parsed from the regulation records in the dataset and the source record ID is returned with each row. Limits: one material at a time - this is NOT a compliance finding for a whole battery, and not advice or a declaration basis. Ex: calculate_recycled_content_gap(material='cobalt', current_pct=10).

material.description: 材料：cobalt=钴 / lead=铅 / lithium=锂 / nickel=镍

current_pct.description: 当前再生含量（%），由调用方提供

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: calculate_compute_energy_cost
tools.description: Purpose: a transparent compute-facility energy and cost estimate - IT load x PUE x hours (x tariff). Guidelines: supply it_power_kw; optionally pue (otherwise a published benchmark from the dataset is used and cited), hours (defaults to a full year) and electricity_price (without it only energy is returned). Limits: excludes non-cooling auxiliary loads, transmission losses, demand and capacity charges, green-power premia and carbon cost; the tariff must come from the caller. Ex: calculate_compute_energy_cost(it_power_kw=1000, electricity_price=0.6).

pue.description: PUE（可选）；不填则取库内公开基准并标注来源

hours.description: 运行时长（小时），默认 8760（全年）

electricity_price.description: 电价（元/kWh）；不填则只返回用电量

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: query_safety_boundaries
tools.description: Purpose: the citable safety-boundary layer for strength training - look up an exercise x condition pair and get a graded verdict (avoid / precaution / safe-with-modification / recommended / ineffective-for-target) together with the verbatim source quote, the section locator and a content hash for each citation. This is the wedge of the fitness domain: it answers 'is this movement contraindicated for this condition' rather than 'what should I train'. Guidelines: pass exercise and/or condition as an id (fit-ex-*, fit-cond-*) or as a keyword in Chinese or English; optionally filter by verdict; every row carries at least one retrievable source with a quote you can check character-for-character. Limits: **no individualised advice** (never 'what should I do'), no diagnosis, no dosing; this is a curated source-backed subset, so the absence of a pair is NOT evidence that the pair is safe; paid standards and copyrighted books are represented by metadata only and their body text is never reproduced. Ex: query_safety_boundaries(exercise='深蹲'), query_safety_boundaries(condition='osteoporosis'), query_safety_boundaries(verdict='avoid', response_format='json'), query_safety_boundaries(exercise='fit-ex-bench-press', condition='fit-cond-uncontrolled-hypertension').

exercise.description: 动作：id（如 fit-ex-back-squat）或关键词（如 '深蹲' / 'deadlift'）

condition.description: 条件：id（如 fit-cond-osteoporosis）或关键词（如 '妊娠' / 'osteoporosis'）

verdict.description: 按裁定等级过滤（可选）：avoid=禁忌 / precaution=谨慎 / safe_with_modification=可做需改造 / recommended=推荐 / ineffective_for_target=对该目标无效

limit.description: 每页条数（默认 20，最大 100）

offset.description: 分页偏移（默认 0；把 next_cursor 原样回传即可翻页）

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: get_fitness_record
tools.description: Purpose: fetch one full record from the fitness safety-boundary domain by stable id - an exercise, a condition, or an exercise x condition safety boundary - including every citation as a verbatim quote plus its section locator, retrieval timestamp, source content hash and the record's own content hash, so a downstream agent can cite and verify it without re-fetching. Guidelines: get the id from query_safety_boundaries first (or pass name as a keyword when the match is unambiguous); set include_domain_contract=true to also receive the domain contract (id prefixes, required fields, assertion-kind semantics, source-verification summary, hard boundaries). Every record carries assertion_kind - 'explicit' means the source states the conclusion in plain terms, 'derived' means it was inferred from explicit source facts and the reasoning chain is given. Limits: **no individualised advice** and no diagnosis; paid standards / copyrighted books are metadata only; records without source support are not held here at all. Ex: get_fitness_record(id='fit-ex-back-squat'), get_fitness_record(id='fit-ci-machine-resistance-training-vertebral-fracture-risk'), get_fitness_record(name='卷腹', include_domain_contract=true, language='en').

id.description: 记录稳定 id：fit-ex-* / fit-cond-* / fit-ci-*

name.description: 名称关键词（中英皆可）；命中多条时返回候选 id 列表

kind.description: 限定记录类型（配合 name 使用时更精确）

include_domain_contract.description: 同时返回领域契约（id 前缀 / 必填字段 / assertion_kind 语义 / 来源核实结论 / 硬边界）

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).

tools.name: get_cn_eu_mapping
tools.description: Purpose: China-EU carbon footprint crosswalk - for a given product, shows what China's product carbon footprint certification (17 products, SAMR/CNCA) requires, what the EU CBAM/CSRD/ESPR requires, whether the two overlap, what data can be shared, and what is still officially unanswered. Guidelines: call this whenever a question involves exporting to the EU, dual compliance, 'does China's carbon footprint certification get recognized by the EU', or comparing Chinese vs EU carbon requirements. Modes: mode=lookup (default, needs product=), mode=gaps (the honest gap list - what we searched and did NOT find), mode=overview (counts + core conclusions). Limits: the CN/EU factual statements are grade A (official documents); the crosswalk itself is Trustbase Lab's judgment (grade B), NOT an official mapping. There is no official China-EU data mutual-recognition document as of 2026-10-26. Pair with get_carbon_standards / query_cbam_emission_factors for the underlying standards and factors. Ex: get_cn_eu_mapping(product='轮胎'), get_cn_eu_mapping(mode='gaps'), get_cn_eu_mapping(mode='overview', response_format='json')

product.description: 产品名或关键词（中文或英文）。如：轮胎、钢铁、电解铝、水泥、锂离子电池。

mode.description: lookup=按产品查；overview=总览；gaps=缺口清单（最诚实、最有价值）

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (machine-readable).
